Package org.opencastproject.kernel.security

Class TrustedHttpClientImpl

java.lang.Object
org.opencastproject.kernel.security.TrustedHttpClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
TrustedHttpClient
public class TrustedHttpClientImpl extends Object implements TrustedHttpClient
An http client that executes secure (though not necessarily encrypted) http requests.

    • execute

      public org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpResponse execute(org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpRequest request) throws TrustedHttpClientException
      Description copied from interface: TrustedHttpClient
      Executes an HttpRequest using a secure, but not necessarily encrypted, http connection.

      The caller must call TrustedHttpClient.close(ClassicHttpResponse) (or Closeable.close()) once finished reading the response. Consider TrustedHttpClient.execute(ClassicHttpRequest, HttpClientResponseHandler) instead, which takes care of this.

      Specified by:
      execute in interface TrustedHttpClient
      Parameters:
      request - The http request
      Returns:
      the http response returned by the server
      Throws:
      TrustedHttpClientException

    • execute

      public <T> T execute(org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpRequest request, org.apache.hc.core5.http.io.HttpClientResponseHandler<? extends T> handler) throws TrustedHttpClientException
      Description copied from interface: TrustedHttpClient
      Executes an HttpRequest using a secure, but not necessarily encrypted, http connection and hands the response to the given handler. The response is closed once the handler returns.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface TrustedHttpClient
      Parameters:
      request - The http request
      handler - The handler processing the response
      Returns:
      whatever the handler returned
      Throws:
      TrustedHttpClientException

    • execute

      public org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpResponse execute(org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpRequest request, int connectionTimeout, int socketTimeout) throws TrustedHttpClientException
      Description copied from interface: TrustedHttpClient
      Executes an HttpRequest using a secure, but not necessarily encrypted, http connection, waiting for the specified timeouts.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface TrustedHttpClient
      Parameters:
      request - The http request
      connectionTimeout - the wait time in milliseconds at which a connection attempt will throw
      socketTimeout - the maximum time in milliseconds allowed between packets before this method will throw
      Returns:
      the http response returned by the server
      Throws:
      TrustedHttpClientException

    • getSignedUrl

      protected org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpRequest getSignedUrl(org.apache.hc.core5.http.ClassicHttpRequest request) throws TrustedHttpClientException
      If the request is a GET or HEAD, sign the URL and return a new request that is signed.
      Parameters:
      request - The possible request to sign.
      Returns:
      The signed request if the request is a GET or HEAD and is configured to be signed, the request otherwise.
      Throws:
      TrustedHttpClientException - Thrown if there is a problem signing the URL.
